title: OpenTopo Real Godot Viewport Captures
subtitle: Generated by running the toporeview capture scenes in Godot 4.5, not from raw/static layer sheets.

items.label: Phase 1 - Grand Canyon mosaic
items.note: USGS10m stitched same-type DEM with procedural terrain texture.

items.label: Phase 2 - Guadalupe fusion baseline
items.note: DTM terrain plus orthophoto/vegetation/canopy layers at baseline review export.

items.label: Phase 3 - Smokies 4-call mosaic
